items.title: Brioche armchairs, butter sculptures and edible chandeliers: meet the new food artists
items.summary:
Culinary artists are turning fashion shows and design fairs into a feast for the eyes

A pretty Venetian chandelier featuring delicate pink flowers and cascading blue leaves hangs from a ceiling. A hazy, warm light radiates from its tulip bulbs. Suddenly, a woman reaches up and snaps off one of the flower stems, giggling as she begins to nibble it. Welcome to the weird and wonderful world of Laila Gohar. The Egyptian-born, New York-based artist is part of a new wave of culinary artists blurring the lines between sustenance and spectacle, and this troupe have quickly become a firm fixture at fashion parties and design fairs, turning dining into a phenomenon and delight.

Gohar describes the chandelier, made entirely from hand-spun sugar (including the silver chain that suspended it) as her “favourite thing she has done in recent history”. It joins a long list of extravagant yet still edible installations she has created, including lifesize armchairs made of brioche, an entire room constructed with Belgian chocolate and a four-metre-long mortadella that had to be lifted into the party’s venue using a crane.

items.title: Ferrari Sheds Hybrid Tech to Create the Ultimate V6 Track Monster
items.summary:
Summary 

The new Ferrari 296 Challenge Stradale drops its hybrid system.Shedding 310 pounds, the 670-horsepower V6 delivers pure analog speed.Massive aero and a stripped carbon-fiber cabin maximize track performance.

Ferrari has officially unveiled its latest track-focused weapon, the Ferrari 296 Challenge Stradale. Arriving 23 years after the original 360 Challenge Stradale, this new iteration strips away the hybrid system to reduce weight and deliver an analog experience. 

At the heart of the 296 Challenge Stradale sits a tuned 3.0-liter, 120-degree twin-turbo V6 engine. Without the electric motor, the engine produces 670 horsepower at 8,000 rpm and 546 lb-ft of torque, sending power exclusively to the rear wheels via an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission. Dropping the hybrid hardware sheds significant bulk, resulting in a dry weight of just 2,932 pounds, nearly 310 pounds lighter than the GTB. This diet allows the car to launch from zero to 62 mph in just 2.8 seconds and reach a top speed in excess of 186 mph. Around Ferrari’s famed Fiorano test track, it clocks a blistering lap time of 1:18.5, beating the likes of the LaFerrari and SF90 .

Visually, the car leans heavily into its motorsport roots. The GTB ’s active spoiler has been replaced with a massive fixed rear wing, which helps generate over 1,360 pounds of downforce at 155 mph. A newly designed twin-exit exhaust system minimizes back pressure while amplifying the V6’s high-pitched wail. To harness the immense grip, Ferrari has equipped the car with recalibrated semi-active suspension, carbon-ceramic brakes,…
items.t: Ferrari Sheds Hybrid Tech to Create the Ultimate V6 Track Monster

Following a brief stint with Birmingham City, Tom Brady has officially purchased a minority stake in Chelsea FC . According to multiple sources, the seven-time Super Bowl champion quarterback has joined the Clearlake Capital investment vehicle that currently controls the prestigious English Premier League soccer club.

The high-profile deal, navigated with the assistance of defense attorney Alex Spiro, positions the NFL legend as an operating adviser to Clearlake Capital, though he will not hold official voting rights. This strategic pivot arrives just weeks after Brady left his 3.3% minority ownership stake and advisory board position with second-tier English club Birmingham City.

Brady's arrival coincides with a significant boardroom shift for the London-based club. This past September, Todd Boehly and Mark Walter sold their respective shares, handing private equity firm Clearlake Capital full control of Chelsea. Led by Behdad Eghbali and Jose E. Feliciano, Clearlake previously held a 61.5% stake in the consortium that originally purchased the club for £2.5 billion GBP in 2022. While he will not dictate daily operations, Brady's extensive championship experience is poised to help guide the ownership group's long-term vision.…

items.title: Pro-Ject's Ö1 Edition Turntable Puts Austrian Culture Radio on a Glossy Red Plinth
items.summary:
Summary 

Pro-Ject Audio Systems has partnered with Ö1, the culture and classical music station of Austria's public broadcaster ORF, on a special-edition turntableA dedicated DC/AC generator powers the AC motor separately from household mains for constant, near-silent speedThe deck is handmade in Europe and is ready for MC cartridges and Pro-Ject's True Balanced connection

Pro-Ject Audio Systems has introduced the Ö1 Edition Turntable, a special edition made with Ö1, the culture and classical music station run by ORF, Austria's public broadcaster. The deck has a glossy red plinth and matching platter with a white Ö1 logo in the corner. Underneath that finish, it is engineered around one goal, which is to keep playback as stable and quiet as possible.

That goal starts with the drivetrain. Instead of drawing power straight from the wall, the premium AC motor runs off its own precision DC/AC generator, which isolates it from fluctuations in household mains. The result, Pro-Ject says, is a platter that turns at a consistently even speed while the motor stays close to silent.

The motor spins a die-cast aluminum platter weighing 1.7 kg, which adds mass and momentum to keep rotation steady. Pro-Ject precision-balances the platter and fits it with a TPE damping ring that absorbs resonance before it reaches the stylus. The platter is also anti-magnetic. That detail lets the turntable take moving coil cartridges, and it leaves room to move to Pro-Ject's True Balanced connection later.

Out of the box, the setup is built to play right away. A premium 8.6-inch aluminum tonearm…
items.t: Pro-Ject's Ö1 Edition Turntable Puts Austrian Culture Radio on a Glossy Red Plinth

items.title: 'Grand Theft Auto 6' Generates a Record-Breaking $3.8 Billion USD in First-Day Sales
items.summary:
Summary 

Grand Theft Auto 6 has shattered industry records by generating an estimated $3.8 billion in retail sales during its first full dayThe massive figure makes the Rockstar Games title the highest-grossing entertainment launch across any mediumInitial reports indicate the game pre-sold 32.5 million copies and caused massive spikes in global internet traffic

Rockstar Games has officially made history with the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 . According to parent company Take-Two , the highly anticipated sequel generated a staggering $3.8 billion USD in retail sales through the end of its first full day, firmly establishing the title as the biggest entertainment launch across any medium.

Racking up 32.5 million pre-sold copies, the game completely shattered the milestones set by its predecessor, Grand Theft Auto V , which previously earned $1.15 billion USD over five days. To put the new record in perspective, GTA 6 outpaced this year's highest-grossing film, Spider-Man: Brand New Day , which made $2.5 billion USD throughout its entire cinematic run.

The monumental launch caused major ripples across global internet infrastructures. Cloudflare reported that PlayStation 5 downloads in the UK peaked at 8.6 times normal levels, while Rockstar's online services saw traffic surge to 11.2 times normal levels in Australia. The massive 212GB file installation even broke Virgin Media O2's evening traffic record as eager fans rushed to load the game.

items.title: The Great Swoosh Heist: 14 Charged in $22 Million USD Train Robbery Targeting Nike Sneakers

A massive 17-count federal indictment has led to the arrest of 14 defendants in Los Angeles for orchestrating a series of freight train burglariesThe coordinated crew allegedly stole over $22 million USDworth of Nike sneakers and other high-value cargo between February 2024 and August 2026Members of the criminal ring reportedly sold thousands of stolen pairs to an unnamed local resale store for approximately $1.1 million USD

In a massive cargo operation that sounds more like a video game heist than real life, 14 defendants have been arrested in Los Angeles for a sprawling train robbery scheme heavily targeting Nike sneakers. According to a 17-count federal indictment, the crew is charged with burglarizing as many as three dozen freight trains across Southern California between February 2024 and August 2026, resulting in the theft of over $22 million USD in goods.

Federal agents allege that 21-year-old Nathan Angel led the brazen operation, specifically tracking and targeting high-value trains transporting Nike products. Utilizing Instagram to coordinate their crimes, Angel allegedly directed his codefendants to drive rented trucks and vans directly onto railroad tracks to board the boxcars. The crew even documented their exploits, with video evidence appearing to show suspects cutting into shipping containers and flaunting the stolen Nike footwear inside.

New Balance and two-way baseball sensation Shohei Ohtani have officially announced a historic contract extension. Building on a massively successful relationship that began in 2023, the new agreement ensures that the reigning superstar will remain partnered with the sportswear brand for the entirety of his on-field baseball career.

While lifetime deals are a familiar concept in the global sports industry, Ohtani's extension is uniquely structured to exclusively cover his time on the diamond. Beyond the monumental contract, New Balance has further cemented the partnership by officially renaming its state-of-the-art Sports Research Lab near its Boston headquarters in his honor. The brand cited Ohtani's meticulous preparation and status as a trusted voice in helping develop elite athletic gear. "Naming our state-of-the-art Sports Research Lab in his honor reflects how we build at New Balance—coauthored with athletes, not just for them," stated New Balance President and Chief Marketing Officer Chris Davis.

items.title: In a flap: how the butterfly became a symbol of gen Z resilience – and anxiety
items.summary:
The delicate insect has become fashion’s favourite motif again – but having represented sexuality in the 90s and the soul in Greco-Roman times, what does it say about youth culture today?

• Don’t get Fashion Statement delivered to your inbox? Sign up here

In the new Gucci campaign, Mariah Carey blows a goodbye kiss to 2026 in the most Mariahhhh way possible. Dressed in a fake fur coat and an azure dress, she enters a Christmas party to the twinkly sounds of All I Want For Christmas Is You. There are beautiful people, presents wrapped with Gucci string and butterflies, which have been associated with the popstar since her 1997 album, Butterfly, but have recently fluttered back to become a symbol of gen Z defiance and girlhood.

Carey serves as fairy godmother to the other “pop girlies” who have embraced the emblem, from PinkPantheress to Dua Lipa; Rachel Chinouriri to Marina and the Diamonds. At the Academy Museum gala in October, the singer Janelle Monáe looked as if she might take flight in a Robert Wun couture gown, with wide, yonic wings. Elsewhere, Tate McRae recently wore a black sequined butterfly bra and matching butterfly wing belt from lingerie wunderkind Ludovic de Saint Sernin. Both Swedish popstar Zara Larsson and her fans are championing glittery butterfly makeup motifs.
items.t: In a flap: how the butterfly became a symbol of gen Z resilience – and anxiety
